extracted.intended_audience: authors submitting manuscripts to medical journals (completing ICMJE disclosure forms)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for authors on how to complete and submit the ICMJE Disclosure Form and how it is used by journals; explains ICMJE's role (standard-setting, not a repository) and journal-specific variations in submission mechanisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Where to submit the completed form
rubrics_metrics.description: You do not submit your completed form to the ICMJE. ... You should then submit the completed form to the journal where you are submitting your manuscript.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The completed disclosure form must be submitted to the journal to which you submit your paper, not to the ICMJE. If a journal provides an online link to complete and submit the form, submission through that link goes to the journal (not ICMJE). The ICMJE cannot tell you whether a journal received your form — you must contact the journal to confirm receipt.

rubrics_metrics.name: ICMJE form as a standardized approach
rubrics_metrics.description: The ICMJE has developed its Disclosure Form as a means of promoting a standardized approach to such declarations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize the ICMJE form is intended to standardize disclosure across journals, but journals may adopt different forms or mechanisms. Always check the target journal's 'information for authors' for any journal-specific requirements or preferred formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to obtain, complete, and save the form
rubrics_metrics.description: Download the ICMJE form, complete it, and save it on your computer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should download the form from ICMJE (or the journal link if provided), fill it out completely, save a copy locally, and then include or upload that completed form as part of their manuscript submission to the journal per the journal's instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journal-provided online completion/submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Some journal's websites provide a link at which you can complete the disclosure form and submit it directly to the journal's editorial office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When using a journal's online form/link, your completed disclosure is submitted to that journal's editorial office. This does not mean the ICMJE has received your form; the submission remains between you and the journal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Author responsibility to verify receipt
rubrics_metrics.description: The ICMJE cannot tell you whether a journal received your form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you need confirmation that the journal received your completed disclosure form, you must contact the journal directly — it is the author's responsibility to ensure the journal has received all required disclosure documentation.
